note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026, read again in that of 30 October 2026), Curacao, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahweal992j) and average post-tax national income (adiinc992j) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, in ANG of that year, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. ANG has since been replaced by XCG: the figures are carried into XCG at the issuer's fixed rate, 1 ANG to one XCG, the Centrale Bank van Curaçao en Sint Maarten's rate for the Caribbean guilder, legal tender from 31 March 2025, of one Netherlands Antillean guilder to one Caribbean guilder (its FAQ on caribbean-guilder.com; centralbank.cw itself answered with a Cloudflare check and was not read). Read 2026-10-30. Read again 2026-11-03 from the bulk download of 30 October 2026 (its country files dated 30 October 2026): every row quoted here, its year and its currency label stood as before, and no later year was given. Until 2026-11-03 this note and its sources wrote the variable codes with their age and population parts swapped (ahwealj992 for ahweal992j and adiincj992 for adiinc992j), codes no file of the database holds (its README: type, concept, age group, population, as in sptinc992j), and called adiinc992j post-tax disposable income, which its metadata names post-tax national income ([Post-tax national income]=[Post-tax disposable income]+[Public spending]). Its other sources were fetched again on 2026-11-03 and said the same.
